g.text: Different scaling controls, compared on the same tasks
Luna high · separate intended controls · shared cost and latency axes
Common-valid OM2W 226 / WebVoyager 387 / DeepShop 131 · Fixed planned weights 300/595/150
Historical single/60 enforced 60 but advertised 30 · Live windows differ · Actor metrics exclude judging
